description: This is a FastAPI router module for authentication endpoints including register, login, token refresh, and logout using JWT tokens with cookies.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for JWT token response containing access token and expiry.

methods.name: TokenResponse register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user registration, issues tokens, and sets refresh token cookie.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_user(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user login, issues tokens, and sets refresh token cookie.

methods.name: TokenResponse refresh_token(request: Request, response: Response)
methods.description: Uses refresh token from cookie to generate a new access token and rotate refresh tokens.

methods.name: None logout_user(response: Response)
methods.description: Clears the refresh token cookie to log out user.

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^def login_user(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep)) -> /
ctags.signature: (payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^def register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep/
ctags.signature: (payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
